# Grok 1.0.41 composer captures

Styled Herdr captures of Grok Build 1.0.41 (4220f3b224a6) on herdr 0.9.1, taken 2026-09-24 in an isolated lab session.

Grok was launched with `--always-approve --no-alt-screen --reasoning-effort low`, which is the spawn shape Firstmate uses for grok workers.

The titled bottom border is the same width as the top and content rows and carries `Grok 4.7 (low) · always-approve`, with U+00B7 MIDDLE DOT.

These files are replay inputs for `tests/fm-composer-lib.test.sh`.
Do not edit the captured bytes.
Refresh them by recapturing a real idle, post-turn, and typed grok pane.

| File | Pane |
| --- | --- |
| `grok-1.0.41-idle-herdr.ansi` | Startup idle composer, recent ANSI read |
| `grok-1.0.41-postturn-herdr-visible.ansi` | Empty composer after a finished turn |
| `grok-1.0.41-typed-herdr-visible.ansi` | Unsubmitted `deploy the fix now` in that composer |
